newsitem.title: UK: Granada to axe around UK 100 stores.
newsitem.headline: Granada to axe around UK 100 stores.

text.p: British media and leisure company Granada Group Plc said on Friday it planned to close around 100 of its 560 high street stores.
"Today we told staff that we are reviewing the position of stores with a view to closing about 100 of the least profitable and least successful," a company spokeswoman said.
"At this stage locations have not been identified," the spokeswoman added. She said that the the closures would begin from May onwards after a consultation process.
Granada would not be drawn on the number of job losses resulting from the closures. It employs some 1,500 full-time staff and 430 part-timers in its network of stores.
The shops sell household electrical goods and also support the company's television and video rental operations.
However, Granada has been reducing the number of its stores in recent years to end high street duplication and as increasing numbers of customers switch to its direct rental operation.
